plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how a physicist named James McDonald confronted J. Allen Hynek, a scientist who explained UFO sightings for the US government, sometime in the 1960s. The trigger was a wave of sightings in Michigan that had been explained away as swamp gas. According to Michels, McDonald told Hynek he was taking part in a cover-up and that what people saw in Michigan was not swamp gas, which would mean the official explanations were hiding something real.
